app.name: Community Lyrics
app.tagline: Lyrics, translations and transliterations, written together.

home.title: Welcome
home.intro: Sign in or create an account to get started.

hints.display_name: Shown exactly as you type it, in any script.

hints.disambiguation: Optional. Helps tell apart artists with the same name.
hints.title: As written, in its original script.
hints.relationships: A cover, remake, live version or alternate arrangement must belong to the same composition as the recording it relates to. Nothing is copied from the related recording.

errors.title: Something went wrong
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.network_error: Could not reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
errors.unexpected_response: The server sent an unexpected response. Please try again.
errors.email_not_verified: Please verify your email address first. Check your inbox for the link.
errors.forbidden: You do not have permission to do this.
errors.invalid_token: This link is invalid or has expired.
errors.not_found: We could not find what you were looking for.
errors.unavailable: The service is temporarily unavailable. Please try again shortly.
errors.internal: Something went wrong on our side. Please try again.
errors.csrf_header_missing: Your request could not be verified. Reload the page and try again.
errors.malformed_json: The request could not be read.
errors.invalid_body: The request could not be read.
errors.unsupported_media_type: The request could not be read.
errors.invalid_cursor: This page link is no longer valid.
errors.version_conflict: Someone else saved a newer version.
errors.duplicate_identifier: This identifier already belongs to another record. Records are never merged automatically.
errors.recording_has_relationships: This recording is linked to covers or other versions of its composition. Remove those links before moving it to another composition.
errors.referential_conflict: A linked record changed while you were saving. Reload and try again.
errors.concurrent_update: Someone else was saving at the same moment. Please try again.
errors.localization_slot_taken: This language and script already have a name. Edit that one instead; names are never merged automatically.
errors.preferred_slot_taken: Another name is already the preferred one for this language.
errors.alias_exists: This alias already exists for this record.
errors.primary_slot_taken: Another version just became the primary one. Reload and try again.

conflict.title: Someone else changed this
conflict.body: Your changes were not saved because a newer version exists. Reload to see the latest version, then reapply your changes.
